reviews.body: Let's also document it where people will see it.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Should this also cover renames done via alembic's alter_column? That's what I'd have reached for.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Yes, a rename is a drop plus an add from the old pods' point of view. During a rolling deploy both versions run for several minutes, which is exactly what bit us. Add the new column, write both, backfill, switch reads, and drop in a later PR.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Nobody reads ADRs before writing a migration. Please add a short section to CONTRIBUTING too.
